'''Paxtrell Snoygal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a representative for [[Cosmohaul Shipping]]. Due to [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks on Cosmohaul transports, Snoygal hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to protect one such transport, the ''[[Argent Lady]]''.<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Droids Defiant}}</ref>
